title: Read-only mount of a FOREIGN Mongo collection (arbitrary schema, not treenix-shaped).
description: Docs surface as nodes with $path/$type synthesized in memory — the DB is never written (no _path index, no version marker — that's what separates it from t.mount.mongo).

uri.title: Explicit connection string. Prefer uriEnv — secrets stay out of the tree.

uriEnv.title: Name of the env var holding the connection string (e.g. 'POLYMAX_MONGO_URI').

keyField.title: Doc field whose value becomes the node name ('slug' | 'wallet' | '_id').

type.title: Constant $type stamped on every synthesized node.

sort.title: Children order, single key only (e.g. { closeTs: -1 }); _id tiebreak appended.

baseQuery.title: Server-side pre-filter merged into every read.
